# discord_guild_sticker (Resource)

Manages a Discord guild sticker.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (String) Path to the sticker image file (PNG, APNG, GIF, or Lottie JSON). Max 512 KB.
- `name` (String) The name of the sticker (2-30 characters).
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID.
- `tags` (String) The autocomplete/suggestion tags for the sticker (max 200 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the sticker (empty or 2-100 characters).

### Read-Only

- `format_type` (Number) The format type of the sticker (1 = PNG, 2 = APNG, 3 = LOTTIE, 4 = GIF).
- `id` (String) The ID of the sticker.
